biotools.summary: SpikeLab is a text-to-analysis framework designed for neural spike data that uses an agentic system to guide large language models (LLMs) for robust, reproducible, and expert-vetted electrophysiology analysis. It allows complex analyses (e.g., dose-response studies, network structure) to be executed via natural language prompts without requiring the user to write code.
